title: Select lessons with explicit context and adoption basis
statement: The Lessons and improvement Module shall present lessons from an identified available scope using attributable context comparisons and current governing improvement dispositions, preserving exclusions, unavailable sources and unresolved applicability.

what.problem: Lesson lookup can hide unavailable context or turn a proposal into current policy.
what.desired_outcome: Select lessons with explicit context and adoption basis.

why.rationale: SR-036 requires this accountable MOD-009 contribution; source meaning, adoption and evidence authority must remain distinct.

stakeholders: Project decision owners and assurance assessors

conditions: During supported finding analysis, work preparation, proposal disposition or opportunity-based effect assessment as applicable; reconsider when the material basis changes.

contexts: MOD-009 contribution to MOD-017 IF-017 consumed by MOD-012; existing controlled-change, assurance and selected retention boundaries.

how.approach: Apply improvement.md to exact participant-supplied context and observations, preserve missing/contrary support, and confirm authority, adopted effects and retention through their existing owners.

how_much.scope: Complete allocated contribution to SR-036 within the declared finite project/activity/observation scope; no automatic causal discovery, policy adoption or universal effectiveness claim.

acceptance_criteria: Return each relevant lesson with exact inspected basis, mechanism, compared activity conditions and applicability reasoning, including the selected source population and acquisition limits.
Explain material exclusions or contextual differences; insufficient context, unavailable sources and a completely inspected no-match scope remain distinct.

Bind an associated improvement disposition to its authoritative decision and affected version; proposed, rejected, revision-required or unknown dispositions cannot be rendered as adopted current rules.
Keep consultation read-only and source-bound across changed selections; an index, lesson or route status cannot authorize a policy/model change or silently renew applicability.
constraints: Existing Learn contributor confirmation and topic/route custody remain applicable to their actual operations; Design approval does not execute them.

sources.basis: Refine supported lesson characterization, bounded contextual use, accountable proposals and opportunity-based effect assessment through MOD-009 and parent IF-017. Preserve existing Learn confirmation/custody/route boundaries and separate controlled adoption, assurance and retention. Proposed Design only.
